rows.label: COMMANDMENT

rows.label: DISQUISITION

rows.label: CONNOTATION

rows.label: TELEVISION

rows.label: GOOD NIGHT

rows.label: COLOR CHART

rows.label: FUNNY
rows.clue: An account of an amusing incident (usually with a punch line)

rows.label: ACUTE

rows.label: MISSTATEMENT

rows.label: ULTIMATUM

rows.label: LEMMA

rows.label: RUMOR
rows.clue: Gossip (usually a mixture of truth and untruth) passed around by word of mouth

rows.label: FREE LIST

rows.label: GOLDEN RULE
